observedOutputDifferences.detail: The old desktop HTML path defaulted to zh while CLI supplied the selected language. Desktop, protocol and CLI now call the shared export policy with language; cross-entrypoint output and browser validation remain acceptance gates.
The old desktop capped PDF raster scale at 4000/max dimension while CLI defaulted to 3. The shared export policy now owns this rule; exact output checks must still run.
